166: 		if d.Addends != "" {

168: 		}

171: 		hasSlash := strings.HasSuffix(d.URL, "/")

179: 		if pb.IsHtmlIndex() {

183: 		if d.ForcePrefix {

210: 		}

274: func (tp *TargetPaths) deriveLink(pb *pagePathBuilder, format output.Format, pageURL string) {
275: 	upper := len(pb.els)
276: 	if pb.linkUpperOffset > 0 {
277: 		upper -= pb.linkUpperOffset
278: 	}
279: 	link := paths.AddLeadingSlash(path.Join(pb.els[:upper]...))
280: 
281: 	if pb.baseNameSameAsType {
282: 		link = strings.TrimSuffix(link, format.BaseName)
283: 	}
284: 
285: 	if pb.prefixLink != "" {
286: 		link = "/" + pb.prefixLink + link
287: 	}
288: 
289: 	if pb.linkUpperOffset > 0 && !strings.HasSuffix(link, "/") {
290: 		link += "/"
291: 	}
292: 
293: 	if pageURL != "" {
294: 		tp.Link = paths.URLEscape(link)
295: 	} else {
296: 		// This is slightly faster for when we know we don't have any
297: 		// query or scheme etc.
298: 		tp.Link = paths.PathEscape(link)
299: 	}
300: 	if tp.Link == "" {
301: 		tp.Link = "/"
302: 	}
303: 
304: 	tp.SubResourceBaseLink = pb.LinkDir()

338: 	if len(p.els) == 0 {
339: 		p.Add(s)
340: 		return
341: 	}
342: 	old := p.els[len(p.els)-1]
343: 	if old == "" {
344: 		p.els[len(p.els)-1] = s
345: 		return
346: 	}
347: 	if old[len(old)-1] == '/' {
348: 		old = old[:len(old)-1]
